content_text:
Hello everyone,
Tomorrow at 9AM Pacific time, we’ll be sharing a video of a Q&A Roger and James participated in during the first night of a trip they took to Atlanta late last year. The Q&A was conducted before a screening of THE MAN WHO WASN’T THERE and was moderated by Christopher Escobar at the Plaza Theater.
We hope you enjoy it!
